title: Defective product
text: Defective product. Very disappointed. My daughter has a lot of trouble with this cup. You have to suck really hard to get your drink at times. Every time she uses the cup I have to make sure the lower part of the straw is pushed as far up as it can be. We have other Contigo Autospout cups that work great. I talked with my friend that uses these with her daughter and she said she has the same issue with some of them. I won’t purchase another Contigo because of this which is unfortunate because the ones that work good are great.

description: There's no worrying about spills with the Contigo 14-Ounce AUTOSPOUT Striker Kids Bottle (Ultramarine Lillies). Whether your child is sitting on the couch, in the car or at the table, this bottle is designed to avoid the unexpected spills. The straw is designed with a spillproof valve that eliminates spills and leaks, even when the spout is open. Go ahead and let them drink on the couch with this bottle. NOTE: Refer user manual before use.
